_meta.source: US Census ACS 5-year, via Census Reporter (keyless) — tables B25040, B01003, B25035
_meta.fields: tracts: 11-digit GEOID → [population, occupiedUnits, oilUnits, gasUnits, electricUnits, propaneUnits, medianYearBuilt]
_meta.table: B25040 House Heating Fuel; B01003 total population; B25035 median year structure built
_meta.units: counts of occupied housing units; medianYearBuilt is 0 when the tract has no estimate
_meta.missing: 0 tracts had no usable estimate and are absent
_meta.caveat: ACS 5-year estimates carry sampling error; a small tract can swing by hundreds of households. Read as a share, not a count.
